tool.name: disassembler stratify
tool.description: sample a size-capped cohort from harvested candidates by score bin
tool.command: #import re ## stratify reads <target>.scores.json from one directory and names its outputs ## after <target>, so each dataset is staged under its name. We strip a trailing ## .scores.json (or just .json) so a dataset uploaded with the original filename ## does not end up as <name>.scores.json.scores.json. mkdir candidates && #for $scores_file in $scores: #set $raw = str($scores_file.element_identifier) #set $raw = re.sub(r'\.scores\.json$', '', $raw) #set $raw = re.sub(r'\.json$', '', $raw) #set $target = re.sub(r'[^\w.\-]', '_', $raw) ln -s '$scores_file' 'candidates/${target}.scores.json' && #end for disassembler stratify --out-dir candidates #for $b in $score_bins: --score-bin '${b.lo}:${b.hi}:${b.n}' #end for

param.name: scores
param.label: Harvest scores
param.help: The scores JSON datasets produced by disassembler harvest, one per target. Each dataset's name is used as the target name.

repeat.name: score_bins
repeat.title: Score bin
repeat.help: Maps to --score-bin LO:HI:N. Bins must not overlap.

param.name: hi
param.label: Upper score bound (exclusive)
param.help: Bins are half-open, so a bin that should include a perfect containment score of 1.0 needs an upper bound above 1.

param.name: n
param.label: Number of accessions to sample from this bin
param.help: Taken evenly across the bin's score range. A bin with fewer candidates contributes what it has.

tool.help:
@HELP_SUITE@
-----
What it does ************
Cuts a size-capped cohort out of each target's harvested candidates. A planetary kmindex search can return thousands of candidate accessions per target. Score bins let you choose how many to send to the walker from each containment-score range, for example a few strong hits plus a sample of weak ones.
Each bin is a half-open score range ``[LO, HI)`` and a count ``N``. Within a bin, ``N`` accessions are taken evenly across the bin's ranked candidates, not just the top ``N``. Accessions with a score of 0 are never sampled. A bin short on candidates contributes what it has, and the shortfall is not made up from other bins.
-----
Input *****
The **Scores** datasets from **disassembler harvest**, one per target. Each dataset's name is used as the target name.
Bins must not overlap. To sample the same score range twice, run the tool once per set of disjoint bins.
-----
Outputs *******
- **Sampled accessions**: a collection with one accession list per target, highest score first. This is the input for **disassembler walker**. - **Per-bin selections**: a collection with one JSON report per target listing, for every bin, how many accessions were requested, available, and selected, and which ones. - **Summary**: the per-target selection counts in one JSON file.
